newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish wood and paper output fell again in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Finnish wood and paper output fell again in Q2.

text.p: Finnish wood and paper output fell for the third consecutive quarter in the second quarter, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
Gross domestic product (GDP) in the second quarter rose 1.6 percent year-on-year after a 1.4 percent increase in the first quarter, putting first half GDP growth at 1.5 percent, it said.
"Wood and paper pruduction fell for the third consecutive quarter and was almost nine percent lower than in the second quarter last year," SF said.
Second quarter production also fell in forestry and in the restaurant and hotel sector, it said.
"Metal industry production rose five percent. Energy and water supply rose almost eight percent," it said.
Earnings increased 4.7 percent but private consumption rose "only 1.5 percent", SF said.
"Consumers were particularly interested in durable goods such as cars, electrical appliances and white goods," it said.
Investment in machines and equipment increased over 14 percent but investment in construction fell further by some four percent in the second quarter, it said.
